compositions.name: Triage first
compositions.largest: the items that need the person, as roomy rows in one column: who, what they ask, their own words in full, and the decision at the row's end
compositions.needs_person: they are the page: the first rows under the title, each with its actions; when none waits, one line says so and the collection rises into their place
compositions.layout: one centred column of 720-800px; the collection follows in the same column as compact rows, under a header line that holds two counts as type
compositions.fold: the title, every waiting item and the collection's header line; the collection's rows start at or below the fold

compositions.name: List and inspector
compositions.largest: the inspector: the selected item in full, its story first (a request's own words and what it asks for, a member's role and recent activity), its actions at the top
compositions.needs_person: the first group of the list, under its own heading with its count; the screen opens with its first item selected in the inspector
compositions.layout: a list column of 360-420px of two-line rows (a name, one fact) beside an inspector of 640-760px, parted by one hairline; the canvas ends in a margin, never in an empty half
compositions.fold: the first twelve or more rows of the list and the whole of the selected item

compositions.name: Queue beside the table
compositions.largest: the collection as a full table with every column it needs, rows of 40-44px
compositions.needs_person: a column of 320-360px on the canvas's left edge, its rows stacked and parted by hairlines on the ground (no card around them), each with the ask and its decision; it scrolls on its own
compositions.layout: the column and the table side by side from under the title down, the title row spanning both; the table takes the rest of the width
compositions.fold: every waiting item and the table's first fifteen rows

compositions.name: Roster by group
compositions.largest: the collection grouped by its main state or role, each group a section with its heading and count, its items as tiles that wrap across the width: a face or mark, a name and one fact, on the ground with no card surface, a raised step on hover
compositions.needs_person: the first group, its tiles twice as wide as the rest and carrying the ask and the decision; the other groups follow in the order a person scans them
compositions.layout: the groups in one column across the canvas, tiles 200-240px wide in the later groups and 400-480px in the first; groups parted by 32-40px of space, never boxed
compositions.fold: the whole first group and the first row of tiles of the next two groups

compositions.name: Board by state
compositions.largest: columns, one per state the items move through, left to right in the order they move; each column a heading with its count on the ground, its items one raised step above it
compositions.needs_person: the first column, the only one whose items carry actions; the columns after it are for reading
compositions.layout: columns of 280-320px with 16-24px between them, each scrolling on its own past the fold; a column is not a box, only its items are raised
compositions.fold: the heading of every column and the first five or more items of each

compositions.name: Sheet with pinned rows
compositions.largest: one dense table from under the title to the canvas gutters with no card around it: rows of 32-36px, and above it a toolbar of search, state tabs with counts and the primary action
compositions.needs_person: the table's first rows, pinned under its header on a one-step surface, their decision inline at the row's end; they stay while the rest scrolls
compositions.layout: the table's edges meet the canvas gutter, columns sized by their content, figures right-aligned
compositions.fold: the toolbar, every pinned row and twenty or more of the rest, or all of them when fewer

compositions.name: Lead block and rail
compositions.largest: the one block that answers the screen's question (the chart, the map or the list of what changed), two-thirds of the width
compositions.needs_person: a rail of 320-384px on the right, its top level with the lead block's, listing the items that need the person with their actions
compositions.layout: lead and rail on a 1fr 352px grid; below the lead, two or three supporting blocks of unequal widths on the same column lines
compositions.fold: the whole lead block, the rail's first five items and the tops of the supporting blocks

compositions.name: Sentence and stream
compositions.largest: a stream of what changed since the person last looked, grouped by day, each entry one line naming the thing and what happened to it
compositions.needs_person: the page title is a sentence at title size that states the answer ("Three deploys failed since Friday"); the items that need the person follow it, then the stream
compositions.layout: one centred column of 720-840px; figures sit inside sentences, never in tiles
compositions.fold: the sentence, every item that needs the person and the first day of the stream

compositions.name: Ledger of what is watched
compositions.largest: one wide table of the things being watched (services, projects, accounts), a row each with its state, its main figure and a small trend drawn in the row
compositions.needs_person: the rows that need the person sort to the top with their action at the row's end; a header line above the table holds two or three figures as type
compositions.layout: the table across the canvas, figure and trend columns right-aligned in tabular figures
compositions.fold: the header line, every row that needs the person and the first of the rest

compositions.name: Story with properties
compositions.largest: the object's own story in order: its timeline, thread or step trail, 640-760px wide
compositions.needs_person: the decision sits in the header beside the object's name and state, and the story ends at the event that asks for it
compositions.layout: a header row (name, state, primary action) over two columns: the story, and a properties column of 280-320px on the right as label and value lines
compositions.fold: the header, every property and the latest part of the story

compositions.name: Document
compositions.largest: the object read as a document: a title, one sentence stating its state, then its sections in the order a person reads them, properties inline in the text
compositions.needs_person: the sentence under the title names what waits on the person and carries the action at its end
compositions.layout: one centred column of 680-760px; section headings 14-16px at 600 with 32-40px between sections
compositions.fold: the title, the state sentence with its action and the first section

compositions.name: Canvas and inspector
compositions.largest: the object drawn: its graph, diagram, map or preview, filling the canvas
compositions.needs_person: an inspector of 320-360px on the right with the selected part's properties and actions; the screen opens with the part that needs the person selected on the canvas
compositions.layout: the canvas edge to edge under a 44-48px toolbar, the inspector one hairline from it
compositions.fold: the whole drawing and the inspector
